podcast.body: This song gained significant exposure through its use in television and video games. "You remember the Von Bondies from this song, right? It was used all over television and video games for a while."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This track from their 2004 album, "Pond Shop Heart," became a rock radio hit. It helped The Von Bondis form the core of the Detroit Garage Rock revival in the early 2000s, alongside The White Stripes and other bands. "The Von Bondis with C'mon C'mon, with the White Stripes and a few others, they formed the core of the Detroit Garage Rock revival of the early 2000s."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
